Data/Inns.lua, Data/RadarEG.lua, Data/LootEG.lua and Data/QuestsEG.lua are generated from open data of Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), recorded by players of World of Warcraft: Forever
with the EG Link addon and published at https://github.com/JIVESCORP/eg-link-output-wowf.

Data from Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The data was reduced to the innkeepers, vendors with recipes (position, name, items) loot sources (name, items, counts), the quests NPCs offer and take back, and where quest objectives advanced and converted to Lua tables.

Game content in these datasets, such as names, is the property of Blizzard Entertainment.
